Please solve this issue: You are fixing a Minecraft-parity bug in the Pumpkin server (Rust, target MC 26.2). Work only inside this repo.

Bug F1: isRainingAt unimplemented for lightning
Files: `pumpkin/src/world/mod.rs`, `tick_spawning_chunk`
What is wrong: A literal `if true` where the position check belongs.
Verified vanilla behaviour: Four checks: raining, can see sky, heightmap not above the position, and biome precipitation is RAIN.
The change to make: Reuse the existing `is_raining_at` helper. Also gate on the ramped levels (`rainLevel > 0.2`, `thunderLevel > 0.9`), not the raw booleans.
Be careful: **A previous attempt read the biome at `heightmap + delta.y`**, which is 0-15 blocks above the surface, and that suppresses lightning vanilla allows. Probe the strike position itself.

Make the smallest change that fixes exactly this. Do not touch unrelated code. When done, run `cargo build -p pumpkin` and make sure it compiles, then stop. Do not commit.
